newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-FERNANDEZ THROUGH AS BELGIAN RETIRES HURT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-FERNANDEZ THROUGH AS BELGIAN RETIRES HURT.

text.p: Veteran American Mary Joe Fernandez booked her first grand slam semifinal berth in four years when Dominique van Roost of Belgium retired hurt at the Australian Open on Wednesday.

Fernandez, a beaten finalist in Melbourne in 1990 and 1992 and seeded 14th this year, was leading 7-5 4-0 when van Roost, visibly pained and close to tears because of a back injury, forfeited the match after 66 minutes of play.
Van Roost, 23, had been one of the tournament giant-killers, beating number two seed Arantxa Sanchez Vicario of Spain in the third round and then 15th seed Chanda Rubin of the United States.
